title: Tqiv Araxt the Enraged and Tqiv Qukret the Furious
summary: Coordinate the two twins' deaths before the survivor absorbs its partner's power.
overview: Coordinate the two twins' deaths before the survivor absorbs its partner's power.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Balance damage and finish the second twin within thirty seconds of the first.

phases.label: Constructs
phases.description: Clear both sides and prepare coordinated boss damage.

phases.label: Twin finish
phases.description: Defeat the survivor before its thirty-second absorption timer expires.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Clear the constructs on each side to remove the matching twin's protection.
Once a twin is active, its thirty-minute failure timer can restore protection and respawn four constructs.
A twin's death starts a thirty-second absorption window on the survivor. If that expires, the survivor heals fully and gains stronger defenses, melee and spells.
Player or pet deaths to either twin can create hostile spirits.
Each twin drops a progression orb as a ground object.

notes: Approval E385. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
